name: What is involved in the dry rot repair process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the dry rot repair process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The dry rot repair process typically involves identifying and eliminating the moisture source, removing all affected timber and surrounding healthy wood to prevent spread, treating remaining areas with fungicide, and replacing the damaged wood with new, sound timber. Proper ventilation and moisture control measures are then implemented to prevent recurrence. A thorough inspection is the first step to determine the full extent of the damage and ensure a comprehensive repair plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Dry rot repair involves eliminating moisture, removing damaged wood, treating remaining areas, replacing timber, and implementing moisture control to prevent recurrence.
